_metadata.description: Regional selling prices for green hydrogen, grey hydrogen, green ammonia, and grey ammonia (2026). Prices in USD per tonne. Sources: Argus Media, S&P Global Commodity Insights, ICIS, Bloomberg NEF, Platts, regional contract benchmarks.
_metadata.sources: Argus Green Hydrogen Assessment Jan 2026, ICIS European Ammonia Weekly Jan 2026, S&P Global Platts Hydrogen Price Assessments, Bloomberg NEF Hydrogen Market Outlook 2026, CRU Ammonia Market Service, Fertilizer Week

GLOBAL.name: Global (default)
GLOBAL.note: Global average benchmark; actual prices vary widely by region

EU_NW.name: EU - Northwest (Germany, Netherlands, Belgium)
EU_NW.note: Highest green H2 demand; CBAM premium lifting green NH3 value; Rotterdam/Antwerp hub pricing. Grey H2 high due to EU natural gas costs.

EU_SOUTH.name: EU - South (Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece)
EU_SOUTH.note: Growing production hub; lower local demand but export-oriented. Sines/Algeciras as H2 import terminals.

EU_NORDIC.name: EU - Nordic (Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark)
EU_NORDIC.note: HYBRIT/green steel premium for H2; low grey H2 costs due to cheap hydro. Marine fuel NH3 demand emerging at Nordic ports.

US_GULF.name: US - Gulf Coast (TX, LA, MS)
US_GULF.note: Largest H2 production region globally; cheap grey H2 from low gas prices; IRA 45V PTC reduces green H2 cost significantly; NH3 export terminals.

US_CALIFORNIA.name: US - California
US_CALIFORNIA.note: LCFS credit premium ($50-100/tCO2 in 2026) for green H2 in transport; ZEV mandates create demand; higher gas prices than Gulf.

US_MIDWEST.name: US - Midwest (IL, IN, OH, MN)
US_MIDWEST.note: Agricultural NH3 demand (fertilizer); wind-rich production potential; Midwest H2 hub (MachH2). Grey NH3 benchmark: Corn Belt pricing.

US_NORTHEAST.name: US - Northeast (NY, NJ, PA, MA, CT)
US_NORTHEAST.note: High energy costs; port demand for marine fuel NH3; RGGI carbon price adds to grey H2 cost; offshore wind H2 potential.

US_PACIFIC_NW.name: US - Pacific Northwest (WA, OR)
US_PACIFIC_NW.note: Cheap hydro for electrolysis; Pacific NW H2 Hub; port of Tacoma/Portland NH3 import/export.

ME_GULF_EXPORT.name: Middle East - Gulf (SA, AE, OM, QA) Export-Oriented
ME_GULF_EXPORT.note: Cheapest grey H2 globally (gas $1-2/MMBtu). Green H2 projects targeting <$2/kg. NH3 export pricing: FOB Ras Al Khair/Duqm. Most production is export-oriented to EU/Japan/Korea.

ME_DOMESTIC.name: Middle East - Domestic Use
ME_DOMESTIC.note: Lower domestic prices; subsidized gas; captive refinery/petrochemical use. Green H2 displacing grey in refineries as national strategies push transition.

JAPAN.name: Japan
JAPAN.note: Highest willingness-to-pay globally; GX bonds subsidizing green H2 imports; JERA NH3 co-firing at power plants driving massive demand. Import CIF pricing.

KOREA.name: South Korea
KOREA.note: Hydrogen Economy Roadmap; H2 power generation bidding; import-dependent. KOGAS H2 import terminals. SK/Lotte/Samsung H2 projects.

CHINA_EAST.name: China - Eastern/Coastal
CHINA_EAST.note: Sinopec/CNOOC green H2 projects; large domestic demand for refining and chemicals. Grey H2 from coal gasification (cheapest globally). Coastal NH3 import/export.

CHINA_WEST.name: China - Western/Interior (Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Gansu)
CHINA_WEST.note: Cheapest green H2 production globally; massive wind/solar; coal-based grey cheapest. Transport cost to coast adds $500-800/t for H2.

INDIA.name: India
INDIA.note: National Green Hydrogen Mission; SIGHT incentive $0.60/kg for 3 years; massive fertilizer NH3 demand (IFFCO, NFL). Gujarat/Rajasthan green H2 corridors.

AU.name: Australia
AU.note: HPTI $2/kg production incentive; Pilbara/Gladstone export hubs; CIF Japan/Korea pricing for exports. Yara Pilbara ammonia as benchmark.

CHILE.name: Chile
CHILE.note: Among cheapest green H2 potential ($1.5-2.0/kg); Atacama solar + Patagonia wind. No domestic grey H2 baseline (imports). HIF eFuels project in Magallanes.

BRAZIL.name: Brazil
BRAZIL.note: Pecém/Suape green H2 hubs; Fortescue/Casa dos Ventos projects; existing Petrobras grey H2 infrastructure. Export-focused NH3 at Pecém port.

AFRICA_NORTH.name: North Africa (Morocco, Egypt)
AFRICA_NORTH.note: Morocco Offer Maroc targeting EU export; Egypt SCZONE green NH3 for Suez shipping; Masdar/AMEA projects. Cheap solar + proximity to EU market.

AFRICA_SOUTH.name: Southern Africa (South Africa, Namibia)
AFRICA_SOUTH.note: Namibia Tsau //Khaeb mega-project; South Africa Boegoebaai/Saldanha Bay; Sasol coal-to-H2 as grey baseline. Export to EU/Japan.

UK.name: United Kingdom
UK.note: Hydrogen Business Model strike price mechanism; Teesside/Humber industrial cluster; high natural gas prices. CCUS blue H2 competition.

CANADA.name: Canada
CANADA.note: Clean Hydrogen ITC up to 40%; Alberta blue H2 + BC/Quebec green H2; Evolugen/EverWind NS export projects. Federal carbon price $170 CAD/tCO2 in 2030.

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.note: Meridian/Contact green H2 projects; Ballance Agri-Nutrients green NH3 pilot; limited domestic grey H2 baseline. ETS carbon price ~NZ$60.

SINGAPORE.name: Singapore
SINGAPORE.note: Import-only; bunkering hub for marine fuel NH3; Jurong Island refinery/petrochemical demand. Import CIF pricing from Australia/Middle East.
